answer.reason: Two events of the story belong to Syria: David's conquest of it and its great defeat by Israel at Aphek.

clauses.english: was put under garrisons by David, and its people became his servants
clauses.quote: the Syrians became servants to David, and brought gifts

clauses.english: lost a hundred thousand footmen to Israel in one day
clauses.quote: slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day

doubts: Syria has many other episodes (the sieges of Samaria, Hazael's oppression of Israel, Rezin's attack on Judah); only two were chosen as the chief events.
JDG 10:6, 1KI 10:29 and AMO 9:7 mention Syria or its gods only in passing and were not used.
